parameters.query: WITH conv AS (INSERT INTO conversation_state (client_slug, patient_phone_hash, current_intent, handoff_active, opted_out, last_message_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now()) ON CONFLICT (client_slug, patient_phone_hash) DO UPDATE SET current_intent = EXCLUDED.current_intent, handoff_active = EXCLUDED.handoff_active OR conversation_state.handoff_active, opted_out = CASE WHEN $5 THEN true ELSE conversation_state.opted_out END, last_message_at = now() RETURNING id) SELECT conv.id AS conversation_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM appointments a WHERE a.client_slug = $1 AND a.patient_phone_hash = $2 AND a.status IN ('pendiente', 'confirmado')) AS active_appointments FROM conv;
